newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana stocks up slightly, sentiment bearish.
newsitem.headline: Ghana stocks up slightly, sentiment bearish.

text.p: Ghanaian stocks closed barely changed on Wednesday, with cautious investors preferring to stay on the sidelines despite a promising start to the week.
The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share Index remained trapped in a narrow range, adding 0.04 points to 376.92.
Traders said big buyers and foreign investors were still absent from the bourse, leaving it largely to individual players.
The result was an overwhelming 1,163,070 shares offered to 320,630 shares demanded.
Fan Milk Ltd gained three cedis to 408 cedis.
Total market capitalisation was little changed at 3.0166 billion compared with 3.0165 billion from Monday's session.
